blockers.stage: s0+s1 (everything that execs an LLVM tool)
blockers.symptom: sh: exec failed: /TOOLS/CLANG.BIN (also LLD/LLVMAR/OBJCOPY at 72/13/10 MB would fail identically)
blockers.root_cause: kernel exec gate program_too_large(): MAX_PROGRAM_SIZE = USER_INITIAL_CLEAR_SIZE = 0x100000 (1 MiB) (src/include/process.h:42; src/kernel/program_loader.c:63, exec path :855-860 returns -ENOEXEC)
blockers.why_odd: the v2_map_image cap is USER_IMG_SIZE = 128 MiB (:44), so the 1 MiB gate is a standalone exec-path check that contradicts the loader's own cap
blockers.owner: w4-kernel (fix: raise/remove the program_too_large gate for v2 exec, to USER_IMG_SIZE) / w4-clang (flat-format clang is NOT sufficient — even ELF is size-blocked)
blockers.evidence: run2/serial lines 'sh: exec failed: /TOOLS/CLANG.BIN' at ELR 0x1000011020, rc 512

blockers.symptom: with no /TOOLS/SH.BIN (the disk recipe only stages SH at disk root), make's first recipe line exec of the missing SHELL produced 'v2 loader: bad image size 0' + an INFINITE fault/exit respawn loop at ELR 0x100002A5FC flooding serial (hangs the harness)
blockers.fix: selfhost-stage.sh --tools now stages /TOOLS/SH.BIN (done this lane); with it present the loop is gone
blockers.residual: a missing-image exec still wedges the kernel for ~minutes instead of failing cleanly — worth a w4-kernel look (spawn/exec failure path), pre-existing, not this lane's gate
blockers.evidence: run1 serial: 'v2 loader: bad image size 0' + '[KERNEL] User process 5 (/TOOLS/MAKE.BIN) fault! EC: 0x20' repeated ~370k lines; verdict hang
